content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing difficulties downloading programs to two new [product_name] smart relays. I connected to these devices using the network view and attempted to transfer the programs; although no errors appeared, the programs were not successfully downloaded. When accessing the device settings and selecting the 'assign IP address' tab, I received a message stating that the connected base module does not support network connection. [url] I'm unsure what I'm missing here.
Hello [user_name], I couldn't open your provided link, but are your devices version [version_no]? If so, you will need [product_name] [version_no] software.
Have you set both smart relays to RUN mode?
Hello, thanks for the suggestion. I had updated to [version_no], but it seems I needed to resave my project using this version before downloading. That resolved the issue.

analysis.insight_summary: The user was unable to transfer programs to two smart relays over the network despite no errors appearing during download. Attempts to assign an IP address resulted in a notification that the base module lacks network support. The root cause was identified as a need to resave the project in the updated software version to ensure compatibility and successful program deployment.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an uncomplicated process for downloading and deploying configuration files to smart relays via the network, without encountering incompatibility issues related to software versioning.
